problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify CircularAreaRead against the corrected shared CircularAreaLogicalState status semantics. It must consume Init/Write-compatible mixed backing ownership, validate every internal IsEmpty/GetDataLength/DivideRdData callpoint, copy only initialized live bytes, update output and logical FIFO extensionally, preserve physical cells, advance readidx modulo capacity, and set status=0. Error branches must preserve state and output.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Null descriptor, null output, zero requested length, or empty FIFO returns ERROR=1 with all owned resources preserved as applicable. Otherwise actual=min(requested, logical length)>0; output prefix becomes the consumed FIFO prefix, logical FIFO drops that prefix, readidx advances modulo capacity, writeidx/capacity/operations/physical mixed buffer stay unchanged, and status becomes 0. Both wrap and non-wrap memcpy paths consume only Some live cells.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Use the corrected common CircularAreaLogicalState/CircularAreaBackingResource and UCharArray::mixed_full as the sole circular-area ownership at the public boundary and all internal callpoints. Output remains UCharArray::full. Query helper calls preserve exactly the same unified state.
spec_hint: Repair or remove case-lib facts that treat nonzero status as globally full; under corrected semantics status distinguishes full/empty only when readidx=writeidx. Keep CircularAreaReadSuccess extensional and prove callpoint/result facts from logical length plus equal-index conditions. Do not strengthen backing mixed_full to full.
preferred_hidden_properties: direct composition Init success -> Read; Write success -> Read; repeated Read; and Read -> IsEmpty/GetDataLength/Write/Reset/Release under the same shared resource
